Uniform lower bounds α_n≥3·4^{-N}/(4N²) for n≤N, and upper energy tail Σ_{n>N}w_n≤H/(N+1)², prove explicit 16H/T² once T≥8. The elementary discrete inequality is verified at N=4 and decreases thereafter. Witness ratios D/H=n^{-2}, z_n=4^{-n}(n²-1)/n^6 give T_n/n→1 and prove optimal exponent. Python quadratures and finite mixtures were replayed from delivered files, but finite experiments do not replace the analytic proof.

value.rationale: A natural inverse geometric question: infer disk proximity from one scalar, the variance in area of a random relative-rotation Minkowski sum. The analytic noncircular probe detects every Fourier mode, and the L² curvature-weighted a priori energy yields a quantitative optimal logarithmic recovery law for isoperimetric deficit. Its optimality witnesses remain strictly positively curved and perimeter-normalized; this is a geometric ill-posedness boundary rather than an isolated numerical evaluation or a rewording of the mean mixed-area formula.
